summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K reporting the completion of a public offering of $700 million 4.800% Senior Notes due 2029 and $500 million 5.600% Senior Notes due 2036 by Ferguson Enterprises Inc., guaranteed by a subsidiary. The notes were issued under a base indenture supplemented by a third supplemental indenture, with J.P. Morgan and BofA as underwriters. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, spin-offs, or activist involvement are present. This is an ordinary debt issuance under a shelf registration, hence no special-situation classification applies.
